utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Leo! I was just thinking about the repair drive — you wouldn't happen to have a spare toaster lying around, would you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No spare toaster. But heads up: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Sunday? Good to know—I'll pass that along. Guess I'll have to tell Nell her toaster fix is a day later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, Faye. What times are you thinking? I can check the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mina, I think around 9 AM would be fine for the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Cleo, just to confirm—Sunday at the community center, right? No changes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey! So far we're right on track — we've got some folks ready to help patch the swings and we could use a hand setting up the repair station in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great to hear, Mara! I'll be there in the morning to help set up, and I'll bring my toaster along too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Nell! I'll make sure we have a spot for that toaster — see you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Hana, I believe we're starting with the water pump first—that's what Opal and I agreed on the other day.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, the water pump is first, behind the old shed—I've already marked the exact spot on the map.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good—I like that you've got it marked. Makes my morning coffee and toolbox all I need to be ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, everyone. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I have a flyer if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey! Saturday, 10 to 4—got it. I'll bring that old blender I've been meaning to fix.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oren! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old playground and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the playground! I thought it was toasters. I'll be there, just remind me where I put my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Oren! Just bring your can-do spirit—tools are optional, we'll have plenty on site. See you Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive are you referring to—the water pump or the backup generator?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it's the general repair drive – the one that got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Sunday at the community center. I'll bring my wrench and some spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Sam, did you hear Vik's got a repair drive planned for next Saturday? He's talking about fixing up park benches and lawnmowers—sounds like a big day!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh yeah, I actually talked to Vik about it—he's coordinating with me on the park benches. I'm bringing my toolbox and some spare wood.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, so you're already in on it! I was thinking of bringing my old toaster—you think Vik can work his magic on that too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Ira, that's really thoughtful—I was just worrying about whether we'd have enough tools for all the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I'm a bit anxious about the pickup and drop-off spots—hope we have enough volunteers to manage everything smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Ira, bring 'em by. Just don't let Kira talk you into swapping for left-handed wrenches again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is actually going to work this time? No hidden issues?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, yeah, it'll be fine. Just don't overthink it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Faye, did you hear the repair drive got moved? It's now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's a relief, Sunday works much better with school pickup times. I can adjust the volunteer schedule now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm glad they changed it—Sunday at the community center should get more folks out, and the space is way better for organizing all the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at my porch. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday. I'll check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah. Let me know if you can make it—I'll have plenty of tools ready!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You all saw what happened at the playground last Saturday — we patched the swingset and replaced the broken bench. That's proof this drive works.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the supply list almost ready, Mara. Just double-checking we have enough paint for the benches.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Cleo! We'll need at least two cans for the benches near the slide.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, I heard you might be fixing things at the repair drive—do you think my old toaster is worth bringing by?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, the repair drive! Just so you know, they moved it from Saturday to Sunday, and it's at the community center now—so bring that toaster by then!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday—good thing you told me, I'd have shown up a day early!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: So, Bo, remind me again—what exactly are we fixing at the repair drive? I keep forgetting the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, you know, the usual—some broken fences and maybe a leaky pipe. Can't keep track of all the small stuff.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, fences and pipes! Right, right. I thought there were toasters in there somewhere. So this Saturday, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds like a plan, Eli. I'll round up the crew and have everything ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. I'll be there at 8 sharp with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, and Eli—Nell just asked if we could take a look at her old toaster while we're at it. Think we can squeeze that in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Ira, thanks for the extra screws—that helps, but I'm still worried we might not have enough hands for the pickup and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive covers all kinds of things—electronics, clothes, small furniture. I think they teach you how to fix it yourself too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, but if we don't have enough volunteers to man the drop-off points, people won't be able to bring their stuff in the first place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Faye, you heard about the repair drive next Saturday, right? I'm helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I've been coordinating it with the school pickup times. We should be done by 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, that timing works great! I told Oren to swing by around then, and Vik seemed interested too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're telling me that repair drive is actually going to hold up? No hidden issues?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Kira! We've moved it to Sunday at the community center, and everything's set. No hidden issues—just a great opportunity to come together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, Sunday's still on. But are you absolutely sure that repair drive is solid? I don't want any last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, just heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. Got some tools ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Sunday? I thought we were still on for Saturday morning. Did someone change it without telling the rest of us?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I just heard it from the organizers. Guess they wanted more space at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry I'm late—what's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I was hoping you'd have some news about the drive. My roof's been leaking something awful.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, is the repair drive still this Saturday, or did it change to Sunday at the community center? I want to make sure I've got the right day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, so it's Sunday at the community center—got it, and we're working on the water pump, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, are you aware the repair drive got moved from Saturday to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, yeah, I knew—I've been spreading the word. Hope you can still make it on Sunday!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, just checking. You bringing any tools or parts for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: So, are you in for Saturday? I've been telling everyone—it's going to be a great community day!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm already planning to be there. I told Ira I'd help organize the tools at Leo's garage, so count me in!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect! I'll let Cleo and Vik know you're on board too—this is shaping up to be a real neighborhood party!
